Effectively qualify inbound leads and leverage AI tools to provide high-quality opportunities for the sales team, ensuring a strong handoff to Account Executives. Partner with Account Executives to identify and execute territory plans, autonomously managing multiple priorities and actively driving effective pipeline development. Execute a formalised business development process with consistency and creativity, adapting your approach to engage confidently with mid-level and executive contacts. Recommend improvements to business development strategies, processes, documents, and tools to benefit internal teams and external prospects, drawing on data insights and AI-assisted workflows where applicable. What We Need From You Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience Minimum of 0-12 months as a successful Business Development Representative or equivalent success in a BDR role, with proven history of achieving and exceeding monthly quotas for dials, appointments, and opportunities. Strong team player with a collaborative mindset, exceptional communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), and the ability to present to groups of all sizes. Self-motivated and quick to learn new concepts and technologies, with comfort using AI-assisted workflows and modern sales tools to drive productivity. Proficiency with contact management solutions (e.g. Salesforce.com) and Microsoft Office suite, with strong planning, organising, and multi-tasking abilities. Creative problem-solving abilities with an assertive, persistent approach to outreach and a genuine desire to learn and improve. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. What Does Sovos Offer You? The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside! An opportunity to work with a global team Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days! Mentoring Programs Globally recognised Training and Development programs Benefits Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.
